title: Identify jumper-wire connection holes
board_scope: Central A-J terminal strips, rows 1-30; match the actual board orientation before use. No power rails.
review_requirements: Calibrate the selected frame with four known hole centers and two independent check holes.
Review exact insertion holes; proposal-box centers may miss the actual contact.
Explicitly pair the endpoints belonging to each physical wire.
Keep hidden or ambiguous endpoints unresolved.
Changing selected frame invalidates calibration and connection review.

evaluation.variant: Move only the F12 endpoint to F13 and capture again; compare against the original reference only after extraction.
